title: Cited brief over a 10-document on-device corpus
source: RESEARCH_TIERA.md — Tier D of the kickoff ladder ('端末内コーパス10文書→引用つきブリーフ'). Corpus is synthetic (fictional 'Project Aurora') so the facts are controllable and copyright-free; the demand shape is the on-device 'ask my documents' assistant.
spec: Using only my on-device documents, write a short brief answering: (1) when does Aurora launch, (2) who owns the launch, and (3) who owns the security sign-off. Search the corpus, read the relevant documents, and in your final answer cite the document ids you used (e.g. d5) and include the exact dates and names.

corpus.title: Aurora — overview
corpus.body: Project Aurora is an on-device assistant SDK. Public launch is gated on the v1.0 release. The internal codename is northlight.

corpus.title: Aurora — model card
corpus.body: Aurora ships a 2B parameter model quantized to int8. Peak memory is 1.8 GB on a phone.

corpus.title: Aurora — benchmarks
corpus.body: On the internal suite Aurora scores 71 percent composite. Decode runs at 24 tokens per second on an iPhone 17 Pro.

corpus.title: Aurora — pricing
corpus.body: Aurora is free for on-device use. There is no per-token charge because inference is local.

corpus.title: Aurora — roadmap
corpus.body: The v1.0 launch is scheduled for 2026-09-15. A v1.1 with tool-calling follows in Q4.

corpus.title: Aurora — ownership
corpus.body: The launch is owned by Priya Nair, the engineering lead. Sam Okafor owns the security sign-off.

corpus.title: Aurora — risks
corpus.body: The long pole is the security review. If the security sign-off slips, the 2026-09-15 launch date slips with it.

corpus.title: Office move memo
corpus.body: The team moves to the 4th floor on 2026-08-01. Remember to bring your badge for the new door.

corpus.title: Holiday schedule
corpus.body: The office is closed from 2026-12-24 through 2026-12-26 for the winter holiday.

corpus.title: Aurora — security review
corpus.body: The security review targets sign-off by 2026-09-01, owned by Sam Okafor. Two findings remain open.

mock_solution.finish: Aurora launches 2026-09-15 (d5). The launch is owned by Priya Nair and the security sign-off by Sam Okafor (d6, d10). Risk: the security sign-off target is 2026-09-01 (d10); if it slips, the 2026-09-15 launch slips with it (d7).
